text.short: The federation of Basque clubs in North America. Its member roster is the clearest map of where Basque America organized itself.
text.note: Read 16 September 2026: clubs in California, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, Washington, Wyoming, the District of Columbia, British Columbia, Quebec and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon.

sections.heading: Where the clubs are
sections.body: Idaho and Nevada carry the most between them, and Boise alone holds five member organizations. The rooms in this directory sit exactly where the clubs sit — which is the shape of one migration, not a coincidence of restaurant openings.
